sites.evidence_type: N-terminal HA epitope; parallel surface-display screen
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface immunostaining PME 4814.3 ± 818.2 (HA immunostaining, Tedman deep receptor scanning)
sites.rationale: Experimentally validated N-terminal HA epitope insertion (after signal-peptide cleavage where present); surface expression read out by HA immunostaining in Tedman et al. deep receptor scanning.

sources.citation: Tedman et al., Efficient experimental characterization of the GPCRome via deep receptor scanning, Nat Commun 2026 (bioRxiv 2025.09.19.677468, PMC12458215)
sources.claim: N-terminal HA epitope inserted per receptor; surface expression read out by HA immunostaining in a pooled GPCRome deep-receptor-scanning screen.

sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: L3: surface FLAG detection in Expi293F cells confirmed receptor trafficking to the plasma membrane (surface_only). L1: construct used for crystallography of the full-length receptor, implying stable membrane insertion, but no explicit surface or functional assay is described in the clip.
sites.rationale: LTB4R has no signal peptide in its canonical topology; EC1 (residues 1–19) is extracellular and TM1 begins at residue 20, leaving 19 residues of extracellular space N-terminal to the first TM helix. A prepend tag (insert_after_residue=0) sits entirely on the extracellular face, well beyond the >=3-residue TM-boundary requirement. L3 explicitly names LTB4R in a GPCR library with N-terminal FLAG confirmed at the cell surface; L1 corroborates with a full-length membrane-anchored FLAG-tagged hBLT1 construct. No residue number is stated in either clip, and the N-terminus is the sole extracellular terminus of this seven-TM receptor, so the junction is uniquely determined by topology. L3 (PMC10156119): A GPCR library including LTB4R (BLT1) was expressed in Expi293F cells with an N-terminal FLAG tag and C-terminal 1D4 tag on each construct; surface FLAG signal was used to confirm receptor trafficking. L1 (PMC8137929) independently reports a full-length membrane-anchored hBLT1 crystallization construct carrying a FLAG tag at the N-terminus (after an exogenous HA signal sequence and AscI site). No specific residue number is named in either clip; the N-terminus is the only extracellular terminus of this GPCR, so the junction is topology-derived as a prepend before residue 1 (M).

sources.claim: Each GPCR construct includes an N-terminal FLAG tag and a C-terminal 1D4 tag, except for four GPCRs belonging to the Frizzed (FZD) subfamily, which have an N-terminal HA (hemagglutinin) epitope tag and a C-terminal 1D4 epitope tag.

literature_notes: Three ledger lines were evaluated. L1 and L3 both support an N-terminal FLAG tag on the extracellular face of LTB4R; L3 is used as the primary clip because it explicitly confirms surface detection in mammalian cells. L2 reports an LgBiT fusion to the C-terminus of BLT1R; the C-terminus falls in IC4 (residues 290–352, intracellular) and is therefore not a surface tag site — it is recorded in other_positions. The C-terminal 1D4 tag in L3 is similarly intracellular. No ledger line supports any internal extracellular loop insertion for LTB4R, so no internal sites are proposed.

literature_other_positions.note: LgBiT fused to the C-terminus of BLT1R (L2); the C-terminus is residue 352 within IC4 (290–352), which is intracellular — not a surface tag site.
C-terminal 1D4 tag on LTB4R in the GPCR library (L3); same intracellular C-terminus (IC4, 290–352) — not a surface tag site.
